completed: Measured the baseline: 17 sections, 2528 words, 12 sections under 180 words
Fixed pages.yml, which staged _site by explicit filename and would have omitted every new page
Made staging and artifact-completeness verification run on pull requests, not only on main
Extended validate_continuity.py from index.html only to every HTML page in the tree
Added cross-page fragment validation, which did not previously exist
Added null guards to script.js so a page without the full chrome does not lose all JavaScript

Linked the stage from index.html without claiming the unwritten stages exist
remaining: Human review and merge of the pull request
Author the remaining eight stage pages, one Work Package each
Repository administrator enables GitHub Actions as the Pages source

observations: The four FAIL rows above are negative controls and are the evidence, not defects: each was induced deliberately to prove the corresponding check can fire, then reverted. Restore was confirmed byte-identical by sha256 858a4045379167ef.
pages.yml copied site files by explicit name, so a new page would have existed in git, passed every check, and returned 404 in production with no error raised anywhere
validate_continuity.py parsed only index.html, so any link inside a new page was unvalidated
script.js had no null guards; a page lacking the search or menu chrome would throw and lose all JavaScript including the theme toggle
The guide was deepest on how agents are organised (team topology 248 words, repository design 246) and thinnest on what they produce (quality 74, security 92, operations 92)

validate_continuity.py raises AttributeError on a malformed recovery object instead of recording FAIL, so a consumer grepping for CONTINUITY_VALIDATION sees neither PASS nor FAIL. Observed while authoring this checkpoint. Deferred to its own issue rather than fixed in this Work Package.
decisions: Multi-page structure with index.html as the map, rather than progressive disclosure in a single file
Stage pages carry entry criteria, artifacts, roles, evidence and an exit gate, so a stage can be executed rather than described
Artifact completeness is verified on pull requests, converting a silent omission into a failed build
Every new check was proven to fail on purpose before being trusted
assumptions: The Assure page depth and shape are the pattern the remaining eight stages will follow; review may revise it before they are written
Search remains index-scoped; stage pages do not carry the search overlay

blockers.resolution: A human reviews and merges the pull request. Agents must not merge.
Select GitHub Actions as the Pages publishing source, then verify the deployed SHA.
